notes: Deploy notifier first so its daily offer cap is active before the new customer version can enqueue offers. No atomic switch or queue drain is required: the offer.queued payload is unchanged, and old/new customer and notifier versions remain wire- and database-compatible. If the rollout is rolled back, either version can consume the existing queued events; an old customer may still enqueue legacy implied-consent offers, but the notifier cap remains effective while the new notifier is deployed.
